Tess H: Quick async check — Q3 mileposts. Please call out what shipped, what slipped, owners, and one-sentence next steps. Goal: update the tracker by EOD PDT. :clock3:
Alex M: Shipped: embeddings pipeline v1.5 to prod this morning. :shipit:
Alex M: CRs: two small followups in #eng-review (pinging @Jordan P for a quick look).
Jordan P: Re-ranker v2 slipped — tuning exposed memory churn on long-context tests. Root cause: KV cache eviction timing.
Jordan P: Owner: me. Next step: repro + patch, aiming for a canary on dedicated by next Tue. :calendar:
Sanjay R: Dedicated rollout still on track for capacity window next week, but we'll need the storage migration finished to unlock full throughput. Owner: Sanjay + infra.
Maria S: Storage migration blocked by vendor throttling on the bulk copy step — vendor support engaged. Short-term mitigation: smaller batches + exponential backoff. ETA update once vendor confirms. :phone:
Keegan L: From product side — please confirm owners and if any customer commitments change. If re-ranker slips beyond Tue we need to notify two alpha customers.
Alex M: Noted re: customers. Embeddings can temporarily serve as fallback for similarity endpoints. I'll add a routing rule proposal to the tracker.
Jordan P: @Maria S can you share the vendor ticket ID? I'll sync with infra to adjust the canary plan if needed.
Maria S: Ticket #VND-4821. Vendor says they'll raise rate limit after we move to incremental copy. Sharing steps now.
CI Bot: Build status: embeddings-pipeline v1.5 -> success, re-ranker/v2 -> failing (out-of-memory on long-context test).
Alex M: @Jordan P fyi I pushed a tiny config tweak that reduced mem in staging by ~18% — might help.
Jordan P: Will try that patch + adjust eviction window. If green, canary Tuesday morning.
Tess H: Short summary for tracker (please append):
```
- Embeddings v1.5: shipped, owner Alex M, next: followup CRs
- Re-ranker v2: slipped, owner Jordan P, next: patch + canary Tue
- Dedicated rollout: on track, owner Sanjay R, blocker: storage migration (Maria S)
```
Tess H: Actions: @Jordan P update tracker with new ETA, @Maria S paste vendor ticket link in tracker, @Alex M add routing fallback note. I'll send customer notice draft if re-ranker moves past Tue. :email:
Keegan L: Thanks — marking action owners in tracker. :white_check_mark:
Maria S: Added vendor ticket and mitigation steps to tracker.
Jordan P: Updated ETA + will post canary results in this thread.
Tess H: Thanks all. If anything changes ping here or drop a short update in the tracker. :thumbsup:
